direct_reply_pairs.rationale: Darwin answers Gray qualified intermediate-variety and introduced-plant opinions, declines the specific US invitation and requests further observation. Explicit receipt docket predates reply.

without the limitations & doubts which you point out
But this is a mere guess

Will you not come next year

Received Aug 20th. /1856/
